subject.title: fix(cron): bind cron jobs to the durable store session, not the DM policy key

question: Should this fix migrate existing persisted main-collapsed-DM cron bindings to their durable store session, and if so which exact historical job shapes are safe to rewrite?
rationale: The patch changes the binding used for future job creation, while already-stored bindings may require durable-state repair; choosing the safe rewrite predicate and user-facing upgrade behavior is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Add a targeted repair
options.body: Implement a doctor or migration path that rewrites only the proven stale DM policy-key bindings and prove both new and upgraded jobs use the transcript-owning session.

options.title: Scope to new jobs
options.body: Land only the creation-time fix and explicitly document that existing affected jobs must be recreated until a separately approved repair path exists.

recommendation.title: Add a targeted repair
recommendation.body: Implement a doctor or migration path that rewrites only the proven stale DM policy-key bindings and prove both new and upgraded jobs use the transcript-owning session.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR context shows detailed knowledge of the policy-key and durable-store-key boundary, making this contributor the closest available routing candidate.
